articles.summary: Net Sales for the third quarter 2026 were $19.1 million representing a 20% increase over the same period in 2025 Gross Profit for the third quarter 2026 increased 37% over the same period in 2025 primarily driven by higher volumes The combination of Rockwell Medical with Vantive’s global hemodialysis concentrates, hemodialysis machines, water treatment systems, and related consumables and technical services business is projected to generate annual revenue between $400 million and $450 million Rockwell Medical, Inc. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: RMTI), a healthcare company that develops, manufactures, commercializes and distributes a portfolio of hemodialysis products to dialysis providers worldwide, today announced financial and operational results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. “We have maintained solid upward momentum across our business, driven by robust market demand and disciplined execution,” said Mark Strobeck, Ph.D. , President and Chief Executive Officer
articles.title: Rockwell Medical Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Rockwell Medical is acquiring Vantive’s hemodialysis concentrates, hemodialysis machines, water treatment systems, and related consumables and technical services business Acquisition will establish Rockwell Medical as one of the world’s largest hemodialysis providers adding complementary product lines, recurring revenue streams, a global customer base and a fully automated, state-of-the-art manufacturing campus in Medolla, Italy spanning more than one million square feet Combined business projected to generate annual revenue between $400 million and $450 million Acquisition expected to close mid-2027 Conference call and webcast today at 8:00am EST Rockwell Medical, Inc. (the “Company”) (Nasdaq: RMTI), a healthcare company that develops, manufactures, commercializes and distributes a portfolio of hemodialysis products to dialysis providers worldwide, today announced that it has entered into an Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement (“the Agreement”) with Vantive Limited (“Vantive”).
articles.title: Rockwell Medical Announces Transformational Global Hemodialysis Acquisition
